description: This file defines a wizard interface for delegating project tasks within an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form layout, fields, and the logic for copying and updating tasks.

classes.name: wizard_delegate
classes.description: A wizard interface class for delegating tasks, handling task copying, updating, and state transitions.

methods.name: _do_assign
methods.description: Handles copying a task, updating its status, and changing its state based on form input.

methods.name: _ask_auto_complete
methods.description: Pre-fills the form with default values based on the current task, preparing for delegation.
